test_cases.label: Chained variable assignments (1=x)+(2=y)=z
test_cases.code:
vars_d = {'ans': 0.0}
assert statement(TokenizeWrapper('1+2-2=x'), vars_d) == 1.0
assert statement(TokenizeWrapper('2*x+4'), vars_d) == 6.0
assert statement(TokenizeWrapper('(1=x)+(2=y)=z'), vars_d) == 3.0
assert vars_d['z'] == 3.0 and vars_d['ans'] == 3.0
